description: Shared QNS known-answer vectors. Pins the consensus-visible reverse-label encoding and the ML-DSA-87 precompile frame across the SDK, the root scripts, and the Hyperion contracts. Consumed by sdk/src/fixtures.test.ts, scripts/verify-pq-precompiles.js, and test/behavior/. Regenerate only for a deliberate, reviewed encoding change.

mldsaFrame.note: digest = 64 bytes of digestFill, publicKey = 2592 bytes of publicKeyFill, signature = 4627 bytes of signatureFill, context = the ASCII context string; frame layout digest || publicKey || signature || uint8(context.length) || context. The keccak256 pins the exact byte layout, using the 64-byte digest field ratified on 2026-08-25 (QIP review item 9).
